title: Cartwise+ Membership Student Graduation Rates on the Annual Fee
content:
A graduation rate applies to Cartwise+ Annual's period fee for Cartwise+ Membership members leaving the student plan when they move up to Cartwise+ Annual.

| Plan held | Fee charges captured on record | Share of the annual fee paid |
|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 36 or more | 0.8 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 12 to 35 | 0.9 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | fewer than 12 | 1.0 |
| any other plan | any | 1.0 |

## Notes

- **Fee charges captured on record** are all fee charges on the membership over its whole history, of any fee type.
- The rate multiplies Cartwise+ Annual's period fee of 99.00.

## Hypothetical illustrations

| Plan held | Charges on record | Annual fee at the rate |
|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 36 | 99.00 multiplied by 0.8 is 79.20 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 35 | 99.00 multiplied by 0.9 is 89.10 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 11 | 99.00 |
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | 40 | 99.00 |
